pattern: EX-07 closure with the landlord uninformed; IM-L landlord chases a closed request asking whether anything is needed from him; contradictory promise to the tenant
notes: Real cut at the end of the record: the full source history (13 events) is visible, and the Recorded action marker points one past the last event. The agency's earlier handling went wrong: it told the tenant someone would check the machine when they were back (010), closed the request without payment two minutes later (011-012) and never told the landlord, who had approved a visit (009) and now chases on Monday 28 December at 06:30 asking for an update and whether anything is needed from him (013). Expected: reply to the landlord with an honest update and an apology for the silence (the tenant swapped in their own machine on 24 December, his machine is in the garage, nobody has been sent, the request was closed), and ask what he wants done with his machine and whether the tenant's machine may stay connected. The promise to the tenant at 010 is now unbacked: either reopen or note a follow-up to settle it once the landlord answers, and do not book a visit in the meantime. A routine update to a landlord is not an escalation.
